args.title: checkout-api v2.3.1 unhealthy; rolled back to v2.3.0

trace.final:
Done. Summary of actions:

1. **Diagnosed**: checkout-api was running v2.3.1 in all three production regions (us-east, us-west, eu-west) and failing health checks with an 18% error rate. The deployment history showed the most recent healthy production release was **v2.3.0**.
2. **Rolled back**: Deployed v2.3.0 to all production regions.
3. **Verified**: checkout-api is now healthy on v2.3.0 in all regions with a 0.2% error rate.
4. **Opened a SEV2 incident** (INC-0001) documenting the failure, the rollback target, and the post-rollback health status. The on-call engineer has been paged.

Note: The root cause of the v2.3.1 failure is not yet known — the on-call engineer will need to investigate before re-attempting that release.
